lift_N.interpretation: dynamic lift response normalized by the mean-flow-case mean lift

engine_power_W.interpretation: dynamic engine-power response normalized by the mean-flow-case mean power

roll_deg.interpretation: limit-normalized roll response; not a universal aircraft sensitivity scale

pitch_deg.interpretation: limit-normalized pitch response; not a universal aircraft sensitivity scale

heave_m.interpretation: limit-normalized heave response; not a universal aircraft sensitivity scale
